::: {#def-dtype}

#### Data type

A [tensor](#def-tensor)'s **data type** (in PyTorch, its `dtype`) is the kind of number that every one of its entries stores,
such as 64-bit integers (`torch.int64`)
or 32-bit floating-point numbers (`torch.float32`, PyTorch's default for real numbers).
All the entries of one tensor share one data type.
PyTorch's [tensor attributes](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/tensor_attributes.html) page lists them all.

:::
